To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a quantized control law consisting of two compensators and a quantizer can be used for sliding-mode control of a class D power amplifier.

we present a quantized control law that converts a continuous control law to a quantized switching command for a class-D amplifier, that we design the quantized control law in sliding mode to achieve high-quality audio signal reproduction, and that we demonstrate the feasibility of the quantized control scheme in a practical three-level class-D amplifier.

we have developed a new quantized controller that can stabilize the class-D audio power amplifiers with an output filter, and we have built and verified the effectiveness of the new control law in a practical system.

sliding-mode quantized control for class-D amplifiers.
the design and implementation of a sliding-mode quantized controller for class-D audio power amplifiers.
